name: Fal'shivka
source:
Max lives in a shelter. The only thing that threatens him is complete loneliness. But his world will turn upside down when Alina, his long-lost sister, appears on the doorstep!
Now that the family is reunited, everything should finally be fine. Or is the nightmare only just beginning?
